title: BugFixerUpper
body:
## BugFixerUpper
Fixes various Minecraft 1.8.9 bugs.

---

### Fixes
- [MC-1349](https://mojira.dev/MC-1349): "While riding a pig, horse or minecart and using F5, the hand of your character is misplaced"
  - Reset the riding state before rendering the arm.
